PROJECT OVERVIEW

Tawasol CRM is a comprehensive customer relationship management platform designed for enterprise environments. Built with a multi-tenant architecture, it enables organizations to manage customer interactions, sales pipelines, and support tickets across multiple departments while maintaining complete data isolation.

The platform integrates real-time communication features through WebSockets and Agora SDK, allowing seamless browser-based voice calls directly within the CRM interface. An AI-powered agentic chatbot built with Gemini AI automates routine CRUD operations and provides intelligent customer insights.

// SYSTEM DESIGN

ARCHITECTURE

[ Architecture Diagram Placeholder ]

Add your system architecture diagram here

Multi-Tenant Isolation

Database-per-tenant architecture with complete data isolation. Each organization gets dedicated MongoDB collections with row-level security enforced at the application layer.

Real-time Communication

WebSocket integration for live updates across all connected clients. Agora SDK enables browser-to-browser voice calls without external plugins or software installation.

AI Agentic Workflows

Gemini AI integration enables natural language database operations. Users can query, create, update, and delete records through conversational interfaces with contextual understanding.

Enterprise Security

JWT-based authentication with refresh token rotation. Role-based access control (RBAC) with granular permissions for different user types and departments.
